concept.hr: Imenski prostori za PID, mrežu i montiranje izoliraju jedno stablo procesa
concept.en: PID, network and mount namespaces isolate one process tree

summary.hr: Pokreni kontejner i usporedi poglede: unutra je ljuska PID 1, a domaćin je vidi kao 4321; ps bez novog /proc vidi sve, a izolacija ide u jednom smjeru.
summary.en: Start a container and compare the views: inside, the shell is PID 1 and the host sees it as 4321; ps without a new /proc sees all; isolation runs one way.

title.en: ps in a container without a new /proc

concept.hr: echo $$ kaže 1, a ps ispisuje procese domaćina
concept.en: echo $$ says 1, yet ps lists the host's processes

concept.hr: Iznutra ga ni SIGKILL ne ubija; izvana pada cijeli imenski prostor
concept.en: Not even SIGKILL kills it from inside; from outside the whole namespace falls
